image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a tiger beetle (Cicindelinae) resting on sandy soil. The beetle exhibits a metallic green and bronze head and thorax, with cream-colored, irregular markings on its reddish-brown elytra. Its long, slender legs are visible, gripping the ground, and its long filiform antennae extend outwards. Large compound eyes dominate the sides of the head.
